newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello sees strengthening economic conditions.
newsitem.headline: Costello sees strengthening economic conditions.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday he expected strengthening economic conditions in 1997, including stronger employment conditions.
Asked when Australia's low inflation-low wage economy would start producing employment growth, Costello replied: "I think that conditions in the economy will strengthen throughout 1997."
"We believe that the housing cycle is going to strengthen through the course of the year, and that's a very big indicator of job creation," Costello told reporters.
